query: INSERT INTO public.case_revisions(case_id,revision,state,payload,payload_sha256,          published_at,supersedes_revision) VALUES($1,$2,$3::editorial.publication_state,$4,$5,$6,$7)          ON CONFLICT(case_id,revision) DO UPDATE SET state=EXCLUDED.state,payload=EXCLUDED.payload,          payload_sha256=EXCLUDED.payload_sha256,published_at=EXCLUDED.published_at,          supersedes_revision=EXCLUDED.supersedes_revision
